result.instructions: Tools for Gooten, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which Gooten products are in the Drinkware category and what do they cost to ship to Canada?"; "Show my Gooten orders from last week that have not shipped yet."; "What is the tracking number for Gooten order 13-f91acc87-bd23-40d?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gooten data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gooten_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gooten_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gooten_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. gooten_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gooten_list_products
tools.title: List catalog products
tools.description: Browse the Gooten print-on-demand product catalog (public data): product id, name, categories, cheapest price and shipping, stock and deprecation flags. Filter by name text or category; use product_id with gooten_list_product_variants. Prices are in USD for the cheapest variant.

query.description: Only products whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

category.description: Only products in this category (exact name, case-insensitive; see the categories list in the reply).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: gooten_list_product_variants
tools.title: List product variants (SKUs)
tools.description: The orderable variants (SKUs) of a catalog product for a destination country, with option values (size, color, ...) and Gooten's price for your account. SKUs differ by region (inch vs cm sizes). GET /productvariants.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: gooten_get_product_templates
tools.title: Get product templates
tools.description: Print templates for a SKU: how many images are needed, required pixel sizes/DPI, print spaces and layer coordinates, and preview assets. GET /producttemplates.

sku.description: Gooten SKU (product variant), e.g. CanvsWrp-ImgWrp-10x10. See gooten_list_product_variants.

tools.name: gooten_check_stock
tools.title: Check stock for SKUs
tools.description: Which of the given SKUs are out of stock for a destination (country, state, postal code). Returns only the out-of-stock SKUs; an empty list means all are available. Unknown SKUs are an error. POST /variantstatus (a read: nothing is changed).

items.description: Gooten SKU (product variant), e.g. CanvsWrp-ImgWrp-10x10. See gooten_list_product_variants.

state.description: Shipping state/province code, e.g. NY (omit for countries without states).

tools.name: gooten_get_shipping_estimate
tools.title: Get shipping estimate for a product
tools.description: Shipping price range and delivery time for a product to a country: whether expedited is possible and estimated shipping days, plus min/max price and producing country when Gooten returns them. GET /shippriceestimate.

annotations.title: Get shipping estimate for a product

tools.name: gooten_get_shipping_options
tools.title: Get shipping options for a cart
tools.description: Available shipping methods (Standard, Expedited, Overnight) with price and delivery days for a cart of SKUs to a destination. POST /shippingprices (a quote: nothing is ordered).

sku.description: Gooten SKU (product variant), e.g. CanvsWrp-ImgWrp-10x10. See gooten_list_product_variants.

annotations.title: Get shipping options for a cart

tools.name: gooten_get_price_estimate
tools.title: Get price estimate for an order
tools.description: Estimate the cost of an order before placing it: per-item partner price, customer price and tax, plus shipping total, for SKUs shipped to an address. POST /price (a quote: nothing is ordered or charged).

sku.description: Gooten SKU (product variant), e.g. CanvsWrp-ImgWrp-10x10. See gooten_list_product_variants.

annotations.title: Get price estimate for an order

tools.name: gooten_validate_address
tools.title: Validate a shipping address
tools.description: Check a shipping address: validity, a score and Gooten's suggested corrected address. GET /addressvalidation.

tools.name: gooten_list_currencies
tools.title: List supported currencies
tools.description: Currencies Gooten can quote prices in (name, code, display format). GET /currencies.

tools.name: gooten_list_shipping_countries
tools.title: List shipping countries
tools.description: Countries Gooten ships to (code, name, whether supported, measurement system, default currency). By default only supported countries. GET /countries.

include_unsupported.description: Also list countries Gooten does not ship to (default false).

tools.name: gooten_list_print_ready_products
tools.title: List print-ready products
tools.description: Your print-ready products (PRPs: SKUs with artwork already attached) with their variant counts. Paging starts at 1. GET /prpproducts.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: gooten_list_print_ready_variants
tools.title: List print-ready variants
tools.description: Orderable SKUs of your print-ready products, optionally for one PRP product name (from gooten_list_print_ready_products). GET /prpvariants.

product_name.description: A PRP product name; omit for all variants.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: gooten_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search your Gooten orders by free text (name, address, phone...), last name, email, postal code, creation date range or your own user id. Returns order id, items with status and tracking, totals and addresses. Needs the Partner Billing Key. GET /ordersearch.

text.description: Any value related to the order (partner name, address, phone, ...).

last_name.description: Customer last name on the order.

start_date.description: Orders created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Orders created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

unique_user_id.description: Your own user id stored on the orders.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: gooten_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by its Safe Order ID: items with status, tracking numbers and carriers, images, options, totals, shipping and billing addresses, discount and metadata. GET /orders.

order_id.description: Gooten Safe Order ID (the long id like 13-f91acc87-...), as returned by gooten_search_orders (Id).

tools.name: gooten_get_order_billing
tools.title: Get order billing
tools.description: Billing breakdown of an order: product cost per item, shipping, surcharge, tax, fees, discount and total. Takes the numeric Gooten order id (GootenId from gooten_get_order), not the Safe Order ID. Needs the Partner Billing Key. GET /orderbilling.

tools.name: gooten_set_order_status
tools.title: Set order status
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's status. Allowed targets: Cancelled (cancels the whole order), Hold (pause before production) and New (re-submit an order that was fixed, e.g. after an image or address issue; it then goes on to production and billing). Only orders in AccountingIssue, AddressIssue, HoldByCIImageIssue, ImageIssue, NeedsManualApproval, New, ReadyForAccounting, ReadyForImageDl or Pending can change; a held order cannot be released through the API (Gooten support must release it); otherwise Gooten refuses. POST /orderstatus.

order_id.description: Gooten Safe Order ID (the long id like 13-f91acc87-...), as returned by gooten_search_orders (Id).

tools.name: gooten_cancel_order_items
tools.title: Cancel order items
tools.description: WRITE: cancel specific items of an order (cannot be undone). Only items of orders in a pre-production status can be cancelled. Pass the numeric Gooten order id and the order item ids (OrderItemId from gooten_get_order). PUT /orderCancel.
